t: This is the Man Group, the investment management business headquartered at Riverbank House and listed on the London Stock Exchange. It is the world's largest publicly traded hedge fund company, with over 1,800 people and about 178 billion dollars under management as of June 2024. It also sponsored the Man Booker Prize from 2002 to 2019. The firm's founder was James Man, an English sugar-broker and rum merchant who lived from 1755 to 1823.
